rows.name_zh: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会会址
rows.name_en: Site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China
rows.address: 上海市黄浦区淮海中路街道中共第一次全国代表大会会址中国共产党第一次全国代表大会纪念馆(专题展厅)
rows.intro: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会会址，简称中共一大会址，位于中华人民共和国上海市黄浦区淮海中路街道兴业路76、78号，是并排两幢的两层石库门里弄房屋，中国共产党第一次全国代表大会于1921年7月23日至7月30日在76号楼下客堂间举行。中共一大会址在1952年后成为纪念馆，1961年3月4日被中华人民共和国国务院公布为第一批全国重点文物保护单位，1997年被中共中央宣传部公布为第一批全国爱国主义教育示范基地。
rows.review_summary: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会会址是上海的一处历史建筑，建筑底蕴深厚，历史气息浓郁，尽显历史建筑的独特风貌。
rows.intro_en: Site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China, abbreviated as the Site of the First CPC National Congress, is located at Nos. 76 and 78 Xingye Road, Huaihai Zhonglu Subdistrict, Huangpu District, Shanghai, People's Republic of China. It consists of two side-by-side two-story Shikumen lane houses. The First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held in the ground-floor parlor of No. 76 from July 23 to July 30, 1921. After 1952, the site became a memorial museum. On March 4, 1961, it was listed by the State Council of the People's Republic of China in the first batch of Major Historical and Cultural Sites Protected at the National Level, and in 1997 it was designated by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee as one of the first batch of National Patriotism Education Demonstration Bases.
rows.address_en: Site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China
rows.review_summary_en: Site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China: The Site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China is a historic building in Shanghai. With profound architectural heritage and a rich historical atmosphere, it fully displays the unique charm of a historical building.

rows.name_en: Ninghua County Revolutionary Memorial Hall
rows.intro: 宁化县革命纪念馆位于福建省三明市宁化县，是展示当地革命历史的纪念性场馆，通过文物、图片等展陈反映宁化作为革命老区的红色历史，是开展爱国主义教育的重要场所。
rows.intro_en: The Ninghua County Revolutionary Memorial Hall is located in Ninghua County, Sanming City, Fujian Province. It is a commemorative venue showcasing the local revolutionary history. Through exhibits such as artifacts and photographs, it reflects Ninghua's red history as an old revolutionary base area, and it is an important site for patriotic education.

rows.name_zh: 汕头市革命历史博物馆
rows.name_en: Shantou Revolutionary History Museum
rows.intro: 汕头市革命历史博物馆位于广东省汕头市，是一座展示当地革命历史与红色文化的博物馆，通过文物、图片等展品介绍汕头地区的革命斗争历程，是了解地方近现代历史和开展爱国主义教育的场所。
rows.intro_en: The Shantou Revolutionary History Museum is located in Shantou, Guangdong Province. It is a museum showcasing the local revolutionary history and red culture, introducing the revolutionary struggle in the Shantou area through cultural relics, photographs, and other exhibits. It serves as a venue for understanding local modern history and carrying out patriotic education.

rows.name_en: Fang Zhimin Memorial Hall
rows.address: 江西省上饶市弋阳县弋江镇广场北路69号
rows.intro: 方志敏纪念馆位于江西，是为纪念中国共产党革命先烈方志敏而建的纪念馆，馆内陈列其生平事迹和相关文物，是当地重要的爱国主义教育基地。
rows.intro_en: The Fang Zhimin Memorial Hall is located in Jiangxi. It was built in memory of Fang Zhimin, a revolutionary martyr of the Communist Party of China. The hall displays exhibits on his life and related relics, and serves as an important local base for patriotic education.
rows.address_en: No. 69, Guangchang North Road, Yijiang Town, Yiyang County, Shangrao City, Jiangxi Province, China

rows.name_zh: 中国共产党一大·二大·四大纪念馆景区
rows.name_en: Memorial of the First, Second and Fourth National Congresses of the Communist Party of China
rows.address: 上海市虹口区四川北路街道中共四大纪念馆
rows.opening_hours: 周一 全天关闭；周二至周日 09:00-16:30 最晚进入16:00
rows.intro: 中共一大、二大、四大纪念馆位于上海市，是纪念中国共产党早期重要会议的革命历史场馆，通过文物陈列和史料展示介绍党的创建历程，是重要的爱国主义教育基地。
rows.intro_en: The Memorial Halls of the First, Second and Fourth National Congresses of the Communist Party of China are located in Shanghai. They are revolutionary history venues commemorating the Party's important early conferences, introducing the course of the Party's founding through the display of cultural relics and historical materials, and serving as an important patriotic education base.
rows.address_en: Memorial Hall of the Fourth National Congress of the CPC, Sichuan North Road Subdistrict, Hongkou District, Shanghai
rows.opening_hours_en: Monday Closed all day; Tuesday–Sunday 09:00-16:30 last entry 16:00

rows.name_zh: 东固革命根据地博物馆
rows.name_en: Donggu Revolutionary Base Area Museum
rows.intro: 东固革命根据地博物馆位于江西省吉安市青原区东固畲族乡，是纪念土地革命时期东固革命根据地历史的专题博物馆，展示当地革命斗争文物与史料，是红色旅游和爱国主义教育场所。
rows.intro_en: The Donggu Revolutionary Base Museum is located in Donggu She Ethnic Township, Qingyuan District, Ji'an City, Jiangxi Province. It is a specialized museum commemorating the history of the Donggu Revolutionary Base during the Agrarian Revolutionary War period, displaying local revolutionary struggle artifacts and historical materials, and serves as a site for red tourism and patriotic education.

rows.name_zh: 红二十八军军政旧址纪念馆
rows.name_en: Memorial Hall of the Former Site of the Military and Political Headquarters of the 28th Red Army
rows.intro: 红二十八军军政旧址纪念馆位于安徽省岳西县，是纪念红二十八军在鄂豫皖边区坚持三年游击战争历史的红色纪念场馆，也是重要的爱国主义教育基地和红色旅游景点。
rows.intro_en: The Memorial Hall of the Former Site of the 28th Red Army's Military and Political Headquarters is located in Yuexi County, Anhui Province. It is a red memorial venue commemorating the history of the 28th Red Army's three-year guerrilla war in the Hubei-Henan-Anhui border region, and also an important patriotic education base and red tourism attraction.

rows.name_zh: 寻乌县革命历史纪念馆
rows.name_en: Xunwu County Revolutionary History Memorial Hall
rows.intro: 寻乌县革命历史纪念馆位于江西赣州寻乌县，因毛泽东1930年在寻乌开展调查、写下《寻乌调查》而闻名，是了解当地革命历史与调查研究的纪念场所。
name_aliases: 毛泽东寻乌调查纪念馆
rows.intro_en: The Xunwu County Revolutionary History Memorial Hall is located in Xunwu County, Ganzhou, Jiangxi. It is famous for Mao Zedong's investigation in Xunwu in 1930, which resulted in his work "Xunwu Investigation." It is a memorial site for learning about the local revolutionary history and investigative research.

rows.name_en: Lianhua One Rifle Memorial Hall
rows.address: 江西省萍乡市莲花县琴亭镇解放南路
rows.intro: 莲花一枝枪纪念馆位于江西萍乡莲花县，为纪念土地革命时期莲花人民保存一支枪坚持武装斗争的历史而建，是当地重要的红色教育基地和爱国主义教育场所。
rows.intro_en: The Lianhua "One Rifle" Memorial Hall is located in Lianhua County, Pingxiang, Jiangxi. It was built to commemorate the history of the people of Lianhua preserving a single rifle and persisting in armed struggle during the Agrarian Revolutionary War period. It is an important local base for "Red" education and a site for patriotic education.
rows.address_en: South Jiefang Road, Qinting Town, Lianhua County, Pingxiang City, Jiangxi Province, China

rows.name_zh: 中国人民解放军海军诞生地纪念馆
rows.name_en: Memorial Hall of the Birthplace of the Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy
rows.address: 江苏省泰州市高港区白马镇海纪馆路
rows.intro: 中国人民解放军海军诞生地纪念馆位于江苏泰州，是纪念中国人民解放军海军在此诞生的专题纪念馆，馆内陈列相关历史文物与史料，展示人民海军创建与发展的历程。
name_aliases: 人民海军诞生地纪念馆
中国解放军海军诞生纪念馆
rows.intro_en: The Memorial Hall of the Birthplace of the Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy, located in Taizhou, Jiangsu Province, is a specialized memorial commemorating the founding of the PLA Navy here. It displays related historical artifacts and materials, tracing the creation and development of the people's navy.
rows.address_en: Haijiguan Road, Baima Town, Gaogang District, Taizhou, Jiangsu Province

rows.name_zh: 川陕革命根据地万源保卫战战史陈列馆
rows.name_en: Sichuan-Shaanxi Revolutionary Base Area Wanyuan Defense Battle History Memorial Hall
rows.intro: 川陕革命根据地万源保卫战战史陈列馆位于四川万源，是为纪念红军万源保卫战而建的专题纪念馆，通过文物、图片等展示当年红四方面军保卫川陕革命根据地的历史。
name_aliases: 万源保卫战战史陈列馆
rows.intro_en: The Wanyuan Defense Battle History Museum of the Sichuan-Shaanxi Revolutionary Base Area is located in Wanyuan, Sichuan. It is a specialized memorial museum built to commemorate the Red Army's Wanyuan Defense Battle. Through cultural relics, photographs, and other exhibits, it presents the history of how the Fourth Front Red Army defended the Sichuan-Shaanxi Revolutionary Base Area.

rows.name_en: Xu Shiyou in Jiaodong Memorial Hall
rows.address: 山东省青岛市胶州市胶东街道府前路
rows.intro: 许世友在胶东纪念馆位于山东，是纪念开国上将许世友在胶东地区革命战斗历程的专题纪念馆，通过文物、图片等展陈展示其军事生涯与胶东抗战历史，是当地的红色教育基地。
rows.intro_en: The Xu Shiyou in Jiaodong Memorial Hall, located in Shandong Province, is a specialized memorial honoring General Xu Shiyou, a founding general of the PLA, and his revolutionary campaigns in the Jiaodong region. Through artifacts, photographs and other displays, it presents his military career and Jiaodong's wartime resistance history, serving as a local red-education base.
rows.address_en: Fuqian Road, Jiaodong Subdistrict, Jiaozhou, Qingdao, Shandong

rows.name_en: Hundred Regiments Offensive Memorial Hall
rows.intro: 百团大战纪念馆位于山西阳泉，为纪念抗日战争时期八路军发动的百团大战而建，馆内通过文物、图片和史料展示这场战役的历史，是重要的爱国主义教育基地。
rows.intro_en: The Hundred Regiments Offensive Memorial Hall, located in Yangquan, Shanxi, was built to commemorate the Hundred Regiments Offensive launched by the Eighth Route Army during the War of Resistance. Through relics, photographs, and historical documents, it presents the history of this campaign and is an important base for patriotic education.

rows.name_en: Zhou Enlai's Former Residence
rows.address: 重庆市两江新区五里店街道嘉陵江
rows.intro: 周公馆位于重庆市渝中区中山四路，是抗战时期周恩来在重庆居住和办公的旧址，也曾是中共中央南方局的重要活动场所，现为红色旅游参观地。

photos.title: File:周公馆·周恩来故居·上海.jpg

rows.intro_en: The Zhou Mansion is located on Zhongshan 4th Road in Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It is the former residence and office of Zhou Enlai in Chongqing during the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, and it also served as an important venue for the Southern Bureau of the CPC Central Committee. Today, it is a red tourism site.
rows.address_en: Jialingjiang, Wulidian Subdistrict, Liangjiang New Area, Chongqing

rows.name_zh: 石家庄平山县西柏坡景区
rows.name_en: Xibaipo Scenic Area, Pingshan County, Shijiazhuang
rows.address: 河北省石家庄市平山县西柏坡镇领袖风范雕塑园-抽烟区西柏坡纪念馆
rows.intro: 西柏坡景区位于石家庄市平山县，解放战争时期曾是中共中央所在地，党中央在此指挥三大战役、召开七届二中全会，素有“新中国从这里走来”的美誉。
rows.intro_en:
Location: Xibaipo Scenic Area, Pingshan County, Shijiazhuang

The Xibaipo Scenic Area is located in Pingshan County, Shijiazhuang. During the Liberation War, it served as the seat of the CPC Central Committee, where the Party Central Committee directed the Three Major Campaigns and convened the Second Plenary Session of the Seventh Central Committee. It has long been renowned as "the place from which New China set out."
rows.address_en: Xibaipo Scenic Area, Pingshan County, Shijiazhuang

rows.name_en: Hunan South Uprising Memorial Hall
rows.intro: 湘南起义纪念馆位于湖南省郴州市，是为纪念1928年朱德、陈毅领导的湘南起义而建立的纪念场馆，馆内通过文物、图片和史料展示起义的历史经过与革命精神，是当地的红色教育基地。
rows.intro_en: The Hunan Southern Uprising Memorial Hall is located in Chenzhou, Hunan Province. It was established to commemorate the Hunan Southern Uprising led by Zhu De and Chen Yi in 1928. Through artifacts, photographs, and historical documents, the hall presents the course of the uprising and its revolutionary spirit, serving as a local red education base.

rows.name_en: 359th Brigade Land Reclamation Memorial Hall
rows.address: 新疆维吾尔自治区阿拉尔市金银川路街道三五九旅屯垦纪念馆
rows.intro: 三五九旅屯垦纪念馆位于新疆阿拉尔市，为纪念三五九旅部队屯垦戍边历史而建，展示其转战南北疆、开发建设塔里木的历程，是了解兵团精神与军垦文化的重要场所。
rows.intro_en: The 359th Brigade Land Reclamation Memorial Museum is located in Aral City, Xinjiang. It was built to commemorate the land reclamation and frontier defense history of the 359th Brigade, showcasing its journey of fighting across northern and southern Xinjiang and developing and building up the Tarim region. It is an important place to learn about the Corps spirit and military reclamation culture.
rows.address_en: No. 359 Brigade Reclamation Memorial Hall, Jinyinchuan Road Subdistrict, Alar, Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

rows.name_zh: 新四军黄桥战役纪念馆
rows.name_en: New Fourth Army Huangqiao Campaign Memorial Hall
rows.intro: 新四军黄桥战役纪念馆位于江苏省泰兴市黄桥镇，为纪念1940年新四军在黄桥地区对国民党顽固派军队作战并取得胜利的黄桥战役而设立，是当地的爱国主义教育和红色旅游场所。
rows.intro_en: The New Fourth Army Huangqiao Campaign Memorial Hall is located in Huangqiao Town, Taixing City, Jiangsu Province. It was established in commemoration of the Huangqiao Campaign of 1940, in which the New Fourth Army fought against the stubborn forces of the Kuomintang in the Huangqiao area and achieved victory. It serves as a local site for patriotic education and red tourism.

rows.name_zh: 广安市邓小平故里旅游区
rows.name_en: Deng Xiaoping Hometown Tourist Area, Guang'an
rows.address: 四川省广安市广安区协兴镇邓小平故里
rows.intro: 广安市邓小平故里旅游区位于四川广安，是邓小平的出生地，景区包括邓小平故居陈列馆、故居等景点，环境清幽，是缅怀伟人、了解其生平事迹的重要场所。
rows.intro_en: The Deng Xiaoping's Hometown Tourist Area is located in Guang'an, Sichuan, the birthplace of Deng Xiaoping. The scenic area includes attractions such as the Deng Xiaoping Former Residence Exhibition Hall and the former residence itself. With its tranquil environment, it is an important place for commemorating the great man and learning about his life and deeds.
rows.address_en: Deng Xiaoping Hometown, Xiexing Town, Guang'an District, Guang'an, Sichuan, China

rows.name_zh: 广州市中国共产党第三次全国代表大会会址纪念馆旅游区
rows.name_en: Memorial Museum of the Third National Congress of the Communist Party of China, Guangzhou
rows.address: 广东省广州市越秀区东山街道春园新河浦幼儿园
rows.intro: 广州市中国共产党第三次全国代表大会会址纪念馆旅游区位于广州，是中共三大召开的纪念场馆，通过陈列展览展示相关历史，是重要的红色教育基地和爱国主义参观场所。
rows.intro_en: The Memorial Tourist Area of the Site of the Third National Congress of the Communist Party of China in Guangzhou is located in Guangzhou. It is a memorial venue where the Third National Congress of the CPC was held, presenting related history through exhibitions. It is an important red education base and patriotic tourist site.
rows.address_en: Chunyuan Xinhepu Kindergarten, Dongshan Subdistrict, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province

rows.name_zh: 西柏坡-天桂山风景名胜区
rows.name_en: Xibaipo-Tiangui Mountain Scenic Area
rows.address: 河北省石家庄市平山县北冶乡天桂'归'字碑铭石家庄天桂山风景名胜区
rows.intro: 西柏坡-天桂山风景名胜区位于石家庄平山县，集红色旅游与自然风光于一体，西柏坡曾是中共中央所在地，天桂山则以奇峰秀景和道教建筑闻名。
rows.intro_en: The Xibaipo-Tiangui Mountain Scenic Area, in Pingshan County, Shijiazhuang, combines red tourism with natural scenery. Xibaipo was once the seat of the CPC Central Committee, while Tiangui Mountain is known for its striking peaks, beautiful scenery and Taoist buildings.
rows.address_en: Tiangui 'Gui' Character Stele, Tiangui Mountain Scenic Area, Beiye Township, Pingshan County, Shijiazhuang, Hebei

rows.name_zh: 新县许世友将军纪念馆
rows.name_en: Xinxian General Xu Shiyou Memorial Hall
rows.address: 河南省信阳市新县田铺乡孝母路
rows.intro: 新县许世友将军纪念馆位于河南新县，为纪念出生于此的著名开国将领许世友而建，展示其生平事迹与革命历程，是当地重要的红色旅游和爱国主义教育基地。
rows.intro_en: The General Xu Shiyou Memorial Hall in Xinxian County, Henan Province, was built to commemorate Xu Shiyou, a renowned founding general of the People's Republic who was born here. It showcases his life story and revolutionary career, and serves as an important local site for red tourism and patriotic education.
rows.address_en: Xiaomu Road, Tianpu Township, Xin County, Xinyang, Henan

rows.name_en: Jinggangshan Scenic Area
rows.address: 江西省吉安市井冈山市井冈山自然保护区飞梨段井冈山风景名胜区
rows.intro: 井冈山，位于中華人民共和国江西省西南部，地处湖南省江西省边界的罗霄山脉中段，属於江西省井冈山市，市府设立在厦坪镇。东连江西泰和、遂川两县，南邻湖南炎陵县，西靠湖南茶陵县，北接江西永新县。井冈山最高峰達到海拔2,120米，為中國的一個旅游景點 。
rows.intro_en: Jinggangshan, located in the southwestern part of Jiangxi Province, People's Republic of China, lies in the middle section of the Luoxiao Mountains on the border between Hunan and Jiangxi provinces. It belongs to Jinggangshan City, Jiangxi Province, whose government is seated in Xiaping Town. It borders Taihe and Suichuan counties of Jiangxi to the east, Yanling County of Hunan to the south, Chaling County of Hunan to the west, and Yongxin County of Jiangxi to the north. The highest peak of Jinggangshan reaches an elevation of 2,120 meters, making it a tourist attraction in China.
rows.address_en: Jinggangshan Scenic Area, Feili Section, Jinggangshan Nature Reserve, Jinggangshan, Ji'an, Jiangxi

rows.name_en: Cai Hesen Memorial Hall
rows.address: 湖南省娄底市双峰县永丰街道复兴街261号
rows.intro: 蔡和森纪念馆位于湖南双峰县，是为纪念中国共产党早期重要领导人蔡和森而建的纪念馆，馆内通过文物、图片等资料展示其生平事迹与革命贡献，是当地重要的爱国主义教育场所。
rows.intro_en: The Cai Hesen Memorial Hall is located in Shuangfeng County, Hunan. It was built in memory of Cai Hesen, an important early leader of the Communist Party of China. Through artifacts, photographs, and other materials, the hall showcases his life story and revolutionary contributions, making it an important local site for patriotic education.
rows.address_en: No. 261 Fuxing Street, Yongfeng Subdistrict, Shuangfeng County, Loudi City, Hunan, China

rows.name_en: Luochuan Conference Memorial Hall
rows.address: 陕西省延安市洛川县永乡镇G210(满防线)
rows.intro: 洛川会议纪念馆位于陕西洛川县，为纪念1937年中共中央在此召开政治局扩大会议（洛川会议）而设立，馆内保存会议旧址和相关文物史料，是重要的革命纪念地与爱国主义教育基地。
rows.intro_en: The Luochuan Conference Memorial Hall, located in Luochuan County, Shaanxi Province, commemorates the enlarged meeting of the CPC Political Bureau held here in 1937, known as the Luochuan Conference. It preserves the original conference site and related artifacts and materials, and is an important revolutionary memorial and patriotic education base.
rows.address_en: G210 (Manfang Line), Yongxiang Town, Luochuan County, Yan'an, Shaanxi, China

rows.name_en: Gutian Tourist Area, Shanghang County
rows.address: 福建省龙岩市上杭县古田镇古田旅游区-主席园
rows.intro: 古田旅游区位于龙岩市上杭县古田镇，以古田会议会址为核心，是1929年古田会议的召开地，建有古田会议纪念馆，为国家5A级红色旅游景区。
rows.review_summary: 上杭县古田旅游区是赏花胜地，同时拥有历史建筑，游客既能在此观赏花卉，又能参观游览这里的历史建筑。
rows.intro_en:
Location: Gutian Tourist Area, Shanghang County
The Gutian Tourist Area is located in Gutian Town, Shanghang County, Longyan City. Centered on the Site of the Gutian Conference, it was the venue of the 1929 Gutian Conference and is home to the Gutian Conference Memorial Hall. It is a national 5A-level red tourism scenic area.
rows.address_en:
Location: Gutian Tourist Area, Shanghang County
Gutian Tourist Area - Chairman's Garden, Gutian Town, Shanghang County, Longyan City, Fujian Province
rows.review_summary_en: Gutian Tourist Area in Shanghang County is a great place for flower viewing and also features historical buildings. Visitors can both enjoy the flowers here and tour the historical buildings.

rows.name_en: Jinggangshan Scenic Area
rows.address: 江西省吉安市井冈山市柏露乡井冈山风景名胜区
rows.intro: 井冈山，位于中華人民共和国江西省西南部，地处湖南省江西省边界的罗霄山脉中段，属於江西省井冈山市，市府设立在厦坪镇。东连江西泰和、遂川两县，南邻湖南炎陵县，西靠湖南茶陵县，北接江西永新县。井冈山最高峰達到海拔2,120米，為中國的一個旅游景點 。
rows.intro_en: Jinggangshan, located in southwestern Jiangxi Province, China, lies in the middle section of the Luoxiao Mountains on the Hunan-Jiangxi border, within the city of Jinggangshan, whose seat is at Xiaping Town. It borders Taihe and Suichuan counties of Jiangxi to the east, Yanling County of Hunan to the south, Chaling County of Hunan to the west, and Yongxin County of Jiangxi to the north. Its highest peak rises to 2,120 meters above sea level, and it is a tourist attraction in China.
rows.address_en: Jinggangshan Scenic Area, Bailu Township, Jinggangshan City, Ji'an, Jiangxi

rows.name_en: Peng Xuefeng Memorial Hall, Zhenping County
rows.address: 河南省南阳市镇平县涅阳街道彭雪枫纪念馆
rows.intro: 彭雪枫纪念馆位于河南省南阳市镇平县，是为纪念新四军名将彭雪枫将军而建的纪念场所，馆内陈列其生平事迹与相关文物，是当地重要的爱国主义教育基地。
rows.intro_en: The Peng Xuefeng Memorial is located in Zhenping County, Nanyang, Henan Province. Built in honor of General Peng Xuefeng, a famed commander of the New Fourth Army, it presents his life story and related artifacts, and serves as an important local base for patriotic education.
rows.address_en: Peng Xuefeng Memorial Hall, Nieyang Subdistrict, Zhenping County, Nanyang, Henan

rows.name_zh: 淮安市周恩来故里景区
rows.name_en: Zhou Enlai Hometown Scenic Area, Huai'an
rows.address: 江苏省淮安市淮安区淮城街道永怀路周恩来纪念馆
rows.intro: 淮安市周恩来故里景区位于江苏淮安，是纪念周恩来总理的景区，包括周恩来故居、纪念馆等，是了解其生平事迹和缅怀伟人的重要场所。
rows.intro_en: The Zhou Enlai Hometown Scenic Area, located in Huai'an, Jiangsu Province, is a scenic complex dedicated to Premier Zhou Enlai, encompassing his former residence, the memorial hall and other sites. It is an important place to learn about his life and achievements and to pay tribute to this great statesman.
rows.address_en: Zhou Enlai Memorial Hall, Yonghuai Road, Huaicheng Subdistrict, Huai'an District, Huai'an, Jiangsu, China

rows.name_zh: 中共中央政治局榜罗会议纪念馆
rows.name_en: Memorial Hall of the Bangluo Meeting of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee
rows.intro: 中共中央政治局榜罗会议纪念馆位于甘肃定西通渭县榜罗镇，纪念红军长征途中在此召开榜罗镇会议的历史，展示相关文物史料，是红色旅游和爱国主义教育场所。
rows.intro_en: Location: Memorial Hall of the Politburo Meeting of the CPC Central Committee at Bangluo. The Memorial Hall of the Bangluo Meeting of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee is located in Bangluo Town, Tongwei County, Dingxi, Gansu. It commemorates the history of the Bangluo Town Meeting held here by the Red Army during the Long March, displays related artifacts and historical materials, and serves as a site for red tourism and patriotic education.

rows.name_zh: 确山县临时治安委员会纪念馆
rows.name_en: Queshan County Provisional Public Security Committee Memorial Hall
rows.intro: 确山县临时治安委员会纪念馆位于驻马店市确山县，纪念大革命时期建立的确山县临时治安委员会，是当地开展革命传统教育和爱国主义教育的重要红色纪念场馆。
rows.intro_en: The Queshan County Provisional Public Security Committee Memorial Hall is located in Queshan County, Zhumadian City. It commemorates the Queshan County Provisional Public Security Committee established during the Great Revolution period, and is an important red memorial venue in the area for conducting revolutionary tradition education and patriotism education.

rows.name_zh: 台前县将军渡纪念馆管理所
rows.name_en: Taiqian County Jiangjundu Memorial Hall Administration Office
rows.intro: 将军渡纪念馆位于河南省台前县，为纪念刘邓大军强渡黄河这一历史事件而建，馆内通过文物、图片等展示相关革命历史，是当地重要的爱国主义教育基地和红色旅游景点。
rows.intro_en: The General Crossing Memorial Hall is located in Taiqian County, Henan Province. It was built to commemorate the historic event of the Liu-Deng Army's forced crossing of the Yellow River. Through cultural relics, photographs, and other displays, the hall presents the related revolutionary history. It is an important local patriotic education base and a red tourism attraction.

rows.name_en: Chairman Mao Memorial Hall
rows.address: 北京市东城区东华门街道广场东侧路
rows.intro: 毛主席纪念堂位於中华人民共和国北京市天安门广场南侧、北京中轴线上，其中安放有经特殊处理保存的毛泽东的遗体。该纪念堂是1976年9月9日中国共产党中央委员会主席毛泽东逝世后建造的纪念性建筑物，由中共中央办公厅毛主席纪念堂管理局管理。原址为中华门，1958年後被拆除。1976年11月24日，毛主席纪念堂奠基。1977年9月9日举行落成典礼并对外开放 。
rows.intro_en:
Location: Chairman Mao Memorial Hall

The Chairman Mao Memorial Hall is located on the southern side of Tiananmen Square in Beijing, People's Republic of China, on Beijing's central axis, and houses the specially preserved body of Mao Zedong. The memorial hall is a commemorative structure built after the death of Mao Zedong, Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, on September 9, 1976, and is administered by the Chairman Mao Memorial Hall Administration Bureau of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee. The original site was the Zhonghua Gate, which was demolished after 1958. On November 24, 1976, the foundation stone of the Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was laid. The hall's opening ceremony was held and it was opened to the public on September 9, 1977.
rows.address_en:
Location: Chairman Mao Memorial Hall
East Side of the Square, Donghuamen Subdistrict, Dongcheng District, Beijing

rows.name_en: Zhu De Hometown Scenic Area, Nanchong
rows.address: 四川省南充市仪陇县马鞍镇朱德故里景区
rows.intro: 朱德故里景区位于南充市仪陇县马鞍镇，是老一辈无产阶级革命家朱德的诞生地和成长地，景区内有朱德故居、纪念馆等景点，是红色旅游和爱国主义教育的重要场所。
rows.intro_en: Zhu De's Hometown Scenic Area is located in Ma'an Town, Yilong County, Nanchong City. It is the birthplace and childhood home of Zhu De, a veteran proletarian revolutionary. The scenic area features attractions such as Zhu De's Former Residence and the Memorial Hall, and serves as an important site for red tourism and patriotic education.
rows.address_en: Zhu De Hometown Scenic Area, Ma'an Town, Yilong County, Nanchong, Sichuan, China

rows.name_en: Zhazidong Prison
rows.address: 重庆市沙坪坝区童家桥街道壮志路
rows.intro: 渣滓洞，中共方面称为渣滓洞集中营，位於中华人民共和国重庆市沙坪垻區，原是一个煤洞，由程尔昌于1920年开办，因渣多煤少而得名。其三面環山、一面臨溝，地勢隱蔽。抗日戰爭結束後，被國民政府军统局設为犯人看守所 。关押在此的犯人有“六一大逮捕”案、“小民革”案、“挺进报”案和“上下川东三次武装起义”失败后被捕的中共地下黨員，如江竹筠、许建业、何雪松等，最多时关押人数达三百余人。1949年11月27日，在中國人民解放軍攻佔重慶前夕，多數犯人於重庆一一·二七大屠杀中被處決，僅存15人。

photos.title: File:渣滓洞展出的当年刑具.jpg
File:渣滓洞监狱墙壁上的中国国民党党员守则.jpg
File:眺望歌乐山渣滓洞 - panoramio.jpg

rows.intro_en: Zhazidong, referred to by the Chinese Communist Party as the Zhazidong Concentration Camp, is located in Shapingba District, Chongqing, People's Republic of China. It was originally a coal pit, opened by Cheng Erchang in 1920, and named Zhazidong ("slag hole") because it produced more slag than coal. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and a gully on one side, the site is well hidden. After the end of the War of Resistance Against Japan, it was designated as a detention facility for prisoners by the Bureau of Investigation and Statistics of the National Government. Among those imprisoned here were Communist underground members arrested in connection with the "June 1 Mass Arrest" case, the "Small Min Ge" case, the "挺进报 (Advance Journal)" case, and after the failure of the three armed uprisings in eastern Sichuan, such as Jiang Zhuyun, Xu Jianye, and He Xuesong, with the number of detainees reaching over three hundred at its peak. On November 27, 1949, on the eve of the People's Liberation Army's capture of Chongqing, most of the prisoners were executed in the Chongqing November 27 Massacre, with only 15 surviving.
rows.address_en: About 1 km from the Geleshan Martyrs' Cemetery on Zhuangzhi Road

rows.name_en: Baigongguan (White Mansion)
rows.address: 重庆市沙坪坝区童家桥街道壮志路重庆歌乐山烈士陵园烈士诗文碑林
rows.intro: 白公馆位于重庆沙坪坝区歌乐山，原为军阀别墅，后成为国民党关押革命志士的秘密监狱，因小说《红岩》广为人知，现为著名的红色旅游和教育基地。

photos.title: File:上海沪剧院·白公馆·上海.jpg
File:徐远举交代的保密局白公馆情况 5110.jpg
File:红岩-歌乐山-白公馆(前) - panoramio.jpg
File:红岩-歌乐山-白公馆(后) - panoramio.jpg

rows.review_summary: 白公馆是一座历史建筑，承载着岁月的痕迹，古朴的风貌令人感受到浓厚的历史气息，值得前来细细品味。
rows.intro_en: Baigongguan (White Mansion) is located on Gele Mountain in Shapingba District, Chongqing. Originally a warlord's villa, it later became a secret prison of the Kuomintang where revolutionaries were held. It became widely known through the novel Red Crag and is now a famous "red tourism" and education site.
rows.address_en: No. 63 Zhifa Village 3, Zhuangzhi Road, Tongjiaqiao Subdistrict, Chongqing, China
rows.review_summary_en:
Location: Baigongguan (Bai Mansion)
Baigongguan (Bai Mansion) is a historic building bearing the traces of time. Its quaint appearance conveys a rich sense of history, making it well worth a visit to savor slowly.

rows.name_en: Baofeng Central Plains Liberation Memorial Hall
rows.address: 河南省平顶山市宝丰县文峰街道中原解放纪念馆
rows.intro: 宝丰中原解放纪念馆位于河南省平顶山市宝丰县，是为纪念解放战争时期中原解放区历史而建的纪念馆，馆内通过文物、图片等展陈再现了中原解放的相关历史，是当地的爱国主义教育场所。
name_aliases: 宝丰县中原解放纪念馆
rows.intro_en: The Baofeng Central Plains Liberation Memorial Hall is located in Baofeng County, Pingdingshan City, Henan Province. It is a memorial hall built to commemorate the history of the Central Plains Liberated Area during the Liberation War. Through exhibits such as cultural relics and photographs, the hall recreates the history of the liberation of the Central Plains, and it serves as a local patriotic education site.
rows.address_en: Central Plains Liberation Memorial Hall, Wenfeng Subdistrict, Baofeng County, Pingdingshan, Henan

rows.name_zh: 中国共产党第三次全国代表大会会址纪念馆
rows.name_en: Memorial of the Site of the Third National Congress of the Communist Party of China
rows.address: 广东省广州市越秀区东山街道寺右二横路10号大院
rows.intro: 中共三大会址纪念馆位于广州东山恤孤院路，1923年中国共产党第三次全国代表大会在此召开，会议促成第一次国共合作，如今是广州重要的红色教育基地和参观纪念场所。
rows.intro_en: The Memorial Hall of the Third National Congress of the Communist Party of China (CPC) is located on Xuguyuan Road in Dongshan, Guangzhou. The Third National Congress of the CPC was held here in 1923, and the congress facilitated the First KMT-CPC Cooperation. Today, it is an important red education base and memorial site in Guangzhou.
rows.address_en: Compound No. 10, Siyou Erheng Road, Dongshan Subdistrict, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong

rows.name_en: Crossing the Yangtze Victory Memorial Hall
rows.address: 江苏省南京市鼓楼区热河南路街道姜家圩60号
rows.intro: 渡江胜利纪念馆坐落于南京长江之滨，为纪念1949年渡江战役胜利而建，馆内通过文物、图片和场景再现解放战争历史，是南京重要的爱国主义教育基地。
rows.intro_en: The Crossing the Yangtze Victory Memorial Hall is situated on the banks of the Yangtze River in Nanjing. Built to commemorate the victory of the 1949 Yangtze River Crossing Campaign, the hall presents the history of the Liberation War through relics, photographs, and recreated scenes, and serves as an important patriotic education base in Nanjing.
rows.address_en: No. 60 Jiangjiawei, Renhenan Road Subdistrict, Gulou District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province

rows.name_en: August 7th Conference Site Memorial Hall
rows.address: 湖北省武汉市江岸区一元街道鄱阳街141号
rows.intro: 八七会议会址纪念馆位于湖北武汉，是纪念1927年中共中央在此召开八七会议的专题纪念馆，会议确立了土地革命和武装反抗国民党反动派的方针。
name_aliases: 江岸区八七会议会址纪念馆
rows.intro_en: The August 7th Meeting Site Memorial Museum is located in Wuhan, Hubei. It is a memorial museum commemorating the August 7th Meeting held here by the CPC Central Committee in 1927, at which the policies of agrarian revolution and armed resistance against the Kuomintang reactionaries were established.
rows.address_en: No. 141 Poyang Street, Yiyuan Subdistrict, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei, China

rows.name_zh: 延安市延安革命纪念地景区
rows.name_en: Yan'an Revolutionary Heritage Scenic Area, Yan'an
rows.address: 陕西省延安市宝塔区宝塔山街道毛泽东雕塑延安革命纪念馆
rows.intro: 延安市延安革命纪念地景区位于陕西延安，包括宝塔山、杨家岭、枣园等革命旧址，是中共中央在延安时期的重要活动地，也是著名的红色旅游胜地和爱国主义教育基地。
rows.intro_en: The Yan'an Revolutionary Memorial Site Scenic Area is located in Yan'an, Shaanxi. It includes revolutionary sites such as Baota Mountain (Pagoda Hill), Yangjialing, and Zaoyuan, which were important locations of activity for the CPC Central Committee during the Yan'an period. It is also a famous red tourism destination and patriotic education base.
rows.address_en: Mao Zedong Sculpture, Yan'an Revolutionary Memorial Hall, Baota Mountain Subdistrict, Baota District, Yan'an, Shaanxi, China

rows.name_zh: 于都中央红军长征集结出发历史博物馆
rows.name_en: Yudu Central Red Army Long March Assembly and Departure Historical Museum
rows.intro: 于都中央红军长征集结出发历史博物馆位于江西省于都县，纪念中央红军长征从此集结出发的历史，展示长征相关文物史料，是了解长征历史、开展红色教育的重要场所。
name_aliases: 中央红军长征出发纪念馆
rows.intro_en: The Yudu Central Red Army Long March Assembly and Departure History Museum is located in Yudu County, Jiangxi Province. It commemorates the history of the Central Red Army assembling and setting out on the Long March from this site, and displays Long March-related relics and historical materials. It is an important venue for learning about the history of the Long March and conducting red education.

rows.name_zh: 望奎县林枫同志故居纪念馆（望奎博物馆）
rows.name_en: Location: Lin Feng's Former Residence Memorial Hall in Wangkui County (Wangkui Museum)
rows.intro: 望奎县林枫同志故居纪念馆（望奎博物馆）位于黑龙江绥化望奎县，为纪念革命家林枫而设，依托其故居旧址陈列相关文物史料，并兼有博物馆展览功能，是当地进行爱国主义教育和了解地方历史的场所。
rows.intro_en: The Lin Feng Former Residence Memorial Hall (Wangkui Museum), in Wangkui County, Suihua, Heilongjiang, was established in honor of the revolutionary Lin Feng. Built around the site of his former residence, it displays related cultural relics and historical materials and also serves as a general museum, making it a local venue for patriotic education and for learning about regional history.

rows.name_zh: 百色市百色起义纪念园景区
rows.name_en: Baise Uprising Memorial Park Scenic Area, Baise
rows.address: 广西壮族自治区百色市右江区永乐镇百色起义英雄雕塑园百色起义纪念园
rows.opening_hours: 1/1-12/31 周一 全天不开放；1/1-12/31 周二–周日 09:00–17:00开放 最晚进入16:30；元旦节,春节,清明节,劳动节,端午节,国庆节 09:00–17:00开放 最晚进入16:30
rows.intro: 百色起义纪念园位于广西百色市，是为纪念百色起义而建的红色旅游景区，园内有纪念馆、纪念碑等设施，是缅怀革命历史、开展爱国主义教育的重要场所。
rows.intro_en: The Baise Uprising Memorial Park is located in Baise, Guangxi. It is a red tourism scenic area built to commemorate the Baise Uprising. The park features facilities such as a memorial hall and a memorial monument, and serves as an important site for remembering revolutionary history and carrying out patriotic education.
rows.address_en: Baise Uprising Memorial Park, Baise Uprising Heroes Sculpture Garden, Yongle Town, Youjiang District, Baise, Guangxi, China

rows.name_en: Former Site of Peasant Movement Institute Memorial Hall
rows.address: 湖北省武汉市武昌区积玉桥街道友谊国际沙湖苑
rows.intro: 农讲所旧址位于武汉市武昌区，1927年由毛泽东主持举办农民运动讲习所，培养了大批农运骨干，现辟为纪念馆，为全国重点文物保护单位。
name_aliases: 武昌农民运动讲习所旧址纪念馆
中央农民运动讲习所旧址
rows.intro_en:
Location: Former Site of the Peasant Movement Institute Memorial Hall

The Former Site of the Peasant Movement Institute is located in Wuchang District, Wuhan. In 1927, Mao Zedong presided over the Peasant Movement Training Institute here, which trained a large number of backbone cadres for the peasant movement. It has now been converted into a memorial hall and is a Major Historical and Cultural Site Protected at the National Level.
rows.address_en: Shahu Garden, Friendship International, Jiyuqiao Subdistrict, Wuchang District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

rows.name_en: Monument to the People's Heroes
rows.address: 北京市东城区东华门街道天安门广场毛主席纪念堂
rows.opening_hours: 周一至周日 05:00-20:30；具体营业状态以当天开放情况为准
rows.intro: 人民英雄纪念碑位于中华人民共和国首都北京市天安门广场的戰爭紀念碑，是1949年中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议为纪念中国近现代史上牺牲的人民英雄而建的纪念碑，是中华人民共和国成立后第一个由国家兴建的大型纪念碑。

rows.intro_en:
Location: Monument to the People's Heroes
The Monument to the People's Heroes is a war memorial located on Tiananmen Square in Beijing, the capital of the People's Republic of China. It was built in 1949 by decision of the First Plenary Session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference to commemorate the people's heroes who sacrificed their lives in modern and contemporary Chinese history, and was the first large-scale monument built by the state after the founding of the People's Republic of China.
rows.address_en: Tiananmen Square (Center of Chang'an Avenue)
rows.opening_hours_en: Monday–Sunday 05:00-20:30; hours subject to same-day opening status

rows.address: 重庆市两江新区观音桥街道嘉陵江

rows.intro_en: Hongyan Village, located in Yuzhong District of Chongqing, was home to the Southern Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and the Chongqing Office of the Eighth Route Army during the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression. The "Hongyan Spirit" takes its name from this place, and the Hongyan Revolutionary Memorial Hall now stands here open to visitors.

rows.intro: 雨花台又名“石子岗”、“玛瑙岗”、“聚宝山”，是南京城南中华门外一座海拔60米的小山。雨花台在古代为佛教胜地，南梁天監二年（503年）因云光法师在雨花台所在山岗设坛讲经说法，虔诚所至，感动上苍，落花如雨，遂得名 。 明、清两代，雨花台的“雨花说法”和“木末风高”分别被列为“金陵十八景”和“金陵四十八景”之一。民国时是刑場，现为雨花台風景区。

rows.intro_en:
Location: Yuhuatai

Yuhuatai, also known as "Shizigang" (Pebble Hill), "Managang" (Agate Hill), and "Jubaoshan" (Treasure-Gathering Hill), is a small hill with an elevation of 60 meters located outside Zhonghua Gate in the south of Nanjing. In ancient times, Yuhuatai was a renowned Buddhist site. In the second year of the Tianjian era of the Liang Dynasty (503 AD), Master Yunguang set up an altar on the hill at Yuhuatai to preach Buddhist scriptures. His devotion moved Heaven, and flowers fell like rain, hence the name Yuhuatai ("Rain of Flowers Terrace"). During the Ming and Qing dynasties, the scenes "Yuhua Shuofa" (Preaching at Yuhua) and "Mumo Fenggao" (High Wind at Treetops) of Yuhuatai were listed among the "Eighteen Scenes of Jinling" and the "Forty-Eight Scenes of Jinling" respectively. During the Republican era, it served as an execution ground, and it is now the Yuhuatai Scenic Area.
rows.address_en: No. 215 Yuhua Road

Location: Yuhuatai Science & Technology Paradise Amusement Park

Yuhuatai Science & Technology Paradise Amusement Park is located in Yuhuatai, Nanjing. It is a theme park combining amusement rides with science and technology elements. The park features a variety of amusement attractions, making it ideal for leisure visits by families with children.

rows.name_en: Cradle of the Republic Scenic Area
rows.address: 江西省赣州市瑞金市沙洲坝镇中央纪委监察部旧址共和国摇篮景区
rows.intro: 共和国摇篮景区位于江西瑞金，是中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府所在地，包含叶坪、沙洲坝等革命旧址群，“红井”故事家喻户晓，是著名的红色旅游胜地。
rows.intro_en: The Cradle of the Republic Scenic Area, located in Ruijin, Jiangxi, was the site of the Provisional Central Government of the Chinese Soviet Republic. It encompasses revolutionary sites including Yeping and Shazhouba. The story of the "Red Well" is well known to every household, making it a renowned red tourism destination.
rows.address_en: Former Site of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and Ministry of Supervision, Shazhouba Town, Ruijin City, Ganzhou, Jiangxi Province, Cradle of the Republic Scenic Area

rows.address: 江苏省南京市玄武区梅园新村街道一汽大众南京黄埔4S店
rows.intro: 铜像]] 中国共产党代表团梅园新村纪念馆是纪念以周恩来为首的中国共产党代表团于1946年5月至1947年3月间在南京与国民政府进行和平谈判的专题性纪念馆，位于中华人民共和国江苏省南京市玄武区梅园新村街道长江路东端。纪念馆包括中共代表团办事处旧址（第四批全国重点文物保护单位）、国共南京谈判史料陈列馆、周恩来铜像和周恩来图书馆。纪念馆筹建于1954年，1977年正式开馆，由杨尚昆题写馆名。1990年1月8日，史料陈列馆开馆。1990年7月1日，周恩来铜像落成。1998年2月21日，周恩来图书馆开馆。

rows.intro_en:
Meiyuan New Village Memorial Hall of the CPC Delegation

Bronze statue]] The Meiyuan New Village Memorial Hall of the Chinese Communist Party Delegation is a memorial museum commemorating the peace negotiations conducted in Nanjing with the Nationalist Government by the Chinese Communist Party delegation led by Zhou Enlai from May 1946 to March 1947. It is located at the eastern end of Changjiang Road, Meiyuan Xincun Subdistrict, Xuanwu District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China. The memorial complex includes the Former Office Sites of the CPC Delegation (listed in the fourth batch of Major Historical and Cultural Sites Protected at the National Level), the Exhibition Hall of Historical Materials on the KMT–CPC Nanjing Negotiations, the Bronze Statue of Zhou Enlai, and the Zhou Enlai Library. Preparation for the memorial began in 1954, and it officially opened in 1977, with its name inscribed by Yang Shangkun. On January 8, 1990, the Exhibition Hall of Historical Materials opened. On July 1, 1990, the Bronze Statue of Zhou Enlai was completed. On February 21, 1998, the Zhou Enlai Library opened.
rows.address_en: Meiyuan Xincun Street, Xuanwu District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province (FAW-Volkswagen Nanjing Huangpu 4S Store), China

rows.name_en: Site of the August 7th Meeting
rows.address: 湖北省武汉市江岸区一元街道长江
rows.intro: 八七会议会址位于中华人民共和国湖北省武汉市江岸区鄱阳街139号，1927年八七会议在此秘密召开。会址建筑原为高级公寓楼“怡和新房”的一部分，在开会当时为苏联人住所。会址被会议亲历者确定后辟为八七会议会址纪念馆 。会址现为全国重点文物保护单位。

rows.intro_en: The Site of the August 7th Meeting is located at No. 139 Poyang Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province, the People's Republic of China. The August 7th Meeting was secretly held here in 1927. The building was originally part of the upscale apartment building known as "Yihe Xinfang" and, at the time of the meeting, served as the residence of Soviet nationals. After the site was confirmed by eyewitnesses of the meeting, it was converted into the Memorial Museum of the Site of the August 7th Meeting. The site is now a Major Historical and Cultural Site Protected at the National Level.
rows.address_en: Yangtze River, Yiyuan Subdistrict, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei

rows.intro: 梅岗位于南京雨花台风景区内，园中遍植梅树，每逢早春梅花绽放、暗香浮动，是南京著名的赏梅胜地之一，与东郊梅花山遥相呼应。
rows.intro_en:
Location: Meigang, Yuhuatai Scenic Area, Nanjing

Meigang is located within the Yuhuatai Scenic Area in Nanjing. The garden is planted with plum trees throughout, and every early spring, when the plum blossoms bloom and a subtle fragrance drifts in the air, it becomes one of Nanjing's famous destinations for admiring plum blossoms, echoing Meihua Mountain (Plum Blossom Hill) in the eastern suburbs.
